reason: Provides a model-facing http_probe tool for bounded GET requests to a deployment-owned target, with validated paths, response-size limits, timeouts, and no automatic redirects.

summaries.zh: 为模型提供面向部署指定目标的受限 HTTP GET 探测工具，并返回带状态、内容类型和截断标记的结构化结果。
summaries.en: Provides a model-facing bounded HTTP GET probe for a deployment-configured target with structured status, content-type, body, and truncation results.

capabilities: Performs bounded HTTP GET requests to a deployment-configured base URL
Reads and returns a capped response body with status and content type
Enforces path validation, timeout limits, and manual redirect handling
